email_body:
Dear PepsiCo BeNeLux Recruitment Team,

I am writing to apply for the Communications Internship (BeNeLux), starting January/February 2027. With a background in digital marketing, SEO and content, and a technical foundation from Applied Computer Science, I am eager to contribute to both external and internal communications for iconic brands like Pepsi, Lay's and Quaker.

In my current roles, I manage websites and create content that engages audiences and drives measurable results. I have hands-on experience with WordPress, social media integration, and writing for the web, which aligns well with maintaining local websites, managing social channels, and assisting with press releases. I am proactive, organized, and comfortable working independently or in a team. My Dutch is at B1 writing level, and I am improving my speaking skills; I am fluent in English and a native Turkish speaker.

I would welcome the opportunity to bring my skills to your team and learn from your communications professionals. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Communications Internship (BeNeLux) at PepsiCo. As a digital marketer with a technical background, I have built and optimized websites, created engaging content, and managed social media integration—skills that directly support the responsibilities of this role. The opportunity to work with iconic brands and contribute to both external and internal communications is exactly the kind of challenge I am looking for.

In my freelance work, I designed and run baverok.com, a WordPress site with a hand-coded landing page, structured data, and an enquiry flow. For mirook.com, I implemented JSON-LD schema and ran technical SEO audits that measurably improved search health. These projects taught me to manage websites independently, write for the web, and use analytics to guide decisions. At Episto, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research, and content for client websites, including publishing and updating pages in WordPress. I also maintain a consistent layout for ~600 member profile pages for a pharmacists' association, which has strengthened my organizational and planning skills.

I am proactive and results-oriented, with strong written communication skills in English and Dutch (B1 writing, A2+ speaking). I am comfortable working in a team and independently, and I enjoy organizing tasks to meet deadlines. I am eager to learn how PepsiCo builds its external communication agenda, from media monitoring to localizing the global sustainability vision, and to contribute to internal channels like PepTalk and internal events.

I would be thrilled to join your team of interns and grow professionally in such a dynamic environment. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to PepsiCo BeNeLux.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• Digital marketing experience with SEO, content creation, and website management, directly applicable to external communications and social media.
• Proficient in WordPress and CMS management, including publishing, updating, and maintaining websites—relevant for local website maintenance.
• Strong written communication skills in English and Dutch (B1 writing), with experience writing SEO content and blog posts.
• Proactive and results-oriented, with proven ability to work independently and in a team, as shown in freelance and client projects.
• Organizational and planning skills demonstrated by managing multiple client websites and maintaining consistent layouts for ~600 profile pages.
